title: BAARC: Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive Partial Spectral Measurement to Full Reconstruction for Material Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.32505v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spectroscopic instruments with limited wavenumber coverage require accurate scan positioning or multiple measurements to complete the material analysis. This often requires prerequisite knowledge about the material under diagnosis to measure the spectral regions with distinguishing peaks. In our study, we simulate a Bayesian Adaptive Acquisition with Reconstruction-driven Classification (BAARC) framework for Raman spectral measurements, using masked training to learn spectral features that dynamically drive laser channel selection until the material is identified. We present a jointly trained two-level framework that takes progressive partial measurements of small wavenumber patches across the complete spectral range and, at each step, first attempts to reconstruct the full spectra until the model uncertainty is low. Secondly, material classification is performed at each reconstruction step until stoppage. Uncertainty quantification duri

translated_title: BAARC：面向材料分类的不确定性驱动的自适应部分光谱测量与全谱重建方法
translated_abstract: 波数覆盖范围有限的光谱仪器需要精确的扫描定位或多次测量才能完成材料分析，这通常需要对待诊断材料具备先验知识，以便测量具有特征峰的光谱区域。在我们的研究中，我们为拉曼光谱测量构建了一个贝叶斯自适应采集与重建驱动分类（BAARC）框架的仿真，该框架采用掩码训练来学习光谱特征，并动态驱动激光通道的选择，直至识别出材料。我们提出了一个联合训练的两级框架：该框架在完整光谱范围内逐步进行小波数片段的部分测量，在每一步中首先尝试重建完整光谱，直到模型的不确定性足够低；其次，在每个重建步骤中进行材料分类，直到满足停止条件。过程中的不确定性量化……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个不确定性驱动的贝叶斯自适应框架BAARC，通过逐步部分光谱测量与全谱重建的联合训练，在无需材料先验知识的情况下实现拉曼光谱材料的自动分类识别。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes BAARC, an uncertainty-driven Bayesian adaptive framework that jointly performs progressive partial spectral measurements and full spectrum reconstruction, enabling automatic material classification from Raman spectra without prior knowledge of the material.
